verdict_reason: Prior items #6, #7 and #8's listed lines are fixed, but Branch coverage claims survive the Branch type's removal, including a link to a deleted test, and SCN-INS-ADDR-037-C now says five roles where the address-book service has six.

todos.issue: The ins-frontend (dd902ca) and ins-tests (3e1d02a) PRs now remove the Branch address type and its tests, but this file still claims coverage of Branch: SCN-INS-ADDR-043-H links 'after a refused save of Branch, choosing it again shows the address, the contact details and the ticked role entered' (address-type.fit.spec.js), a test the ins-frontend diff deletes (ins-frontend diff line 913); SCN-INS-ADDR-044-G 'Branch offers the one role...' (line 5579) stays full on links whose Branch rows are gone (add.fit.spec.js 'Branch row', address-book-add-roles.spec.ts and address-book-country-list.spec.ts 'for Branch' - no Branch row remains in tests/ins or ins-frontend src); SCN-INS-ADDR-044-H/044-I (5626, 5649) cite 'the Branch runs'; SCN-INS-ADDR-038-B (4129) and 039-A (4283) rest their red-probe claims on 'the Branch run', which no longer exists; and SCN-INS-ADDR-043-A (4925) is still named 'offers the four types' while this PR repointed its three links to tests that assert three types. Related to spec item #17, but this is the coverage claim itself.
todos.fix: Must: no link in this file names a deleted test, no scenario claims coverage of the Branch type or rests a strength on a Branch run, and every scenario's name agrees with the tests linked to it, with coverage values re-derived. One way: once spec.md drops the Branch scenarios (#17), delete SCN-INS-ADDR-044-G and the 043-H Branch link, drop 'Branch' from the 044-H/044-I and 038-B/039-A notes (re-rating 039-A if its only probe was the Branch run), rename 043-A to three types, then run tim spec lint.

todos.issue: SCN-INS-ADDR-037-C was renamed 'A create or update carrying a role outside the five is refused naming the roles', but the address-book service has six roles: AddressRole.java:21 BRANCH_ADDRESS(RoleGroup.BRANCH) on origin/main of trade-imports-address-book (no PR in the EUDPA-776 set; read from the live clone, on main). A create holding BRANCH_ADDRESS is accepted, and SCN-INS-ADDR-037-H/037-I in the same spec still rely on the branch role. The links prove only that the literal 'UNSUPPORTED_ROLE' (ins-tests domain/ins/constants/address-book-types.ts:108) and an unknown role in the ITs are refused, so nothing witnesses 'outside the five'.
todos.fix: Must: the scenario states the role set the address-book service actually accepts, and agrees with 037-H and 037-I. One way: revert the name to 'outside the six' here and in spec.md (and the two ins-tests titles), or, if the branch role is to go from the service, add trade-imports-address-book to the PR set and drop BRANCH_ADDRESS there.
